subject: Phased acceptance & MAP: sequencing MSA/DPA/order form dependencies
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@aureliatx.com>, Procurement Team <procure@aureliatx.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Phased acceptance & MAP: sequencing MSA/DPA/order form dependencies

Elena — following our demo last week, attaching an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short sequencing note for the MSA/DPA/order form. Key points for your procurement and legal teams: 

- We propose a phased acceptance approach tied to evaluation milestones (POC validation, integration sign-off, production readiness).
- MSA redline can be agreed in parallel with the evaluation timetable; order form and billing begin after Phase 1 acceptance.
- DPA signatures need to precede any production data access; we can provide a scoped DPA for the evaluation if that helps speed things up.

Attachments: Aurelia_MAP_v1.pdf, MSA_Redwood_draft_v3.docx

Action items: can procurement confirm target sign-off dates for MSA and DPA? Can your engineering contact confirm a 2-week staging window for the eval harness?

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morales <elena@aureliatx.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@aureliatx.com>, Procurement Team <procure@aureliatx.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Oct 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phased acceptance & MAP: sequencing MSA/DPA/order form dependencies

Thanks Markus — the MAP looks sensible. A couple of constraints from our side: 

- Procurement requires an executed MSA before finance will process an order form for any committed spend.
- Our security team needs SOC 2 evidence and a short data flow diagram before we agree to the scoped DPA for evaluation.
- We have a compliance blackout between Oct 20-24; any signatures after Oct 24 will slip our start.

I'll loop in Tom (engineering) on the staging window. Can you provide the SOC 2 snapshot and a one-page data flow for the eval? If you can scope the DPA to a sandbox dataset, Legal may be OK to sign it prior to full DPA.

—Elena
Director, Technical Procurement
Aurelia Therapeutics
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Oct 2025 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Phased acceptance & MAP: sequencing MSA/DPA/order form dependencies

Quick internal — procurement pushed hard on having an executed MSA before finance will sign off on order form spend. Security needs SOC 2 and a data flow before scoped DPA is acceptable. They also have a blackout Oct 20–24. 

Suggested sequencing to keep close timeline intact: 
- Week 0 (Oct 27): Execute scoped DPA for sandbox + provide SOC2 snapshot and 1-page data flow.
- Week 1–2 (Oct 27–Nov 10): Eval/staging window (integration tests + sample workload). Acceptance criteria doc attached to MAP.
- Week 3 (Nov 10–14): Phase 1 acceptance sign-off -> sign Order Form (minimal commitment) via DocuSign. MSA negotiation continues in parallel.
- Week 4–6: Ramp and MSA finalization; full DPA executed before production data access.

Rishi — can legal prioritize the MSA redline so we can offer a clean order form for DocuSign in Week 3? Marissa — confirm that we can restrict evaluation to pseudonymized sandbox data to satisfy their compliance ask.

-Markus
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@aureliatx.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@aureliatx.com>, Procurement Team <procure@aureliatx.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phased acceptance & MAP: sequencing MSA/DPA/order form dependencies — Proposed timeline & links

Elena & Tom — following internal sync, here's the concrete sequencing and links to artifacts: 

Proposed timeline (dates):
- Oct 27: Scoped DPA executed (sandbox scope) + SOC2 snapshot shared + 1-page data flow (Drive link below).
- Oct 27–Nov 10: Integration & eval (test harness, validation suite).
- Nov 11: Phase 1 acceptance (pass validation suite) -> DocuSign order form sent for minimal committed capacity.
- Nov 11–Dec 1: MSA negotiation (reasonable redlines only); production DPA finalized before full prod access.

Artifacts: 
- MAP: https://drive.google.com/file/d/MapFileID (Aurelia_MAP_v1.pdf)
- MSA draft: https://drive.google.com/file/d/MSA_draft_v3
- DocuSign order form (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/launch?envelopeId=0a1b2c3d

If procurement can confirm target sign-off on MSA redlines by Nov 1 we can keep the Nov 11 order signature. Otherwise we should set a soft contingency one week later.

Markus
From: Elena Morales <elena@aureliatx.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@aureliatx.com>, Procurement Team <procure@aureliatx.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phased acceptance & MAP: sequencing MSA/DPA/order form dependencies — Proposed timeline & links

Markus — this is helpful and clean. Procurement confirms they will prioritize the MSA review the week of Oct 27 and aim to provide consolidated redlines by Nov 1. Security reviewed your SOC2 summary and the sandbox-scoped DPA looks acceptable in principle; Tom will confirm the staging window later today.

Please go ahead and send the DocuSign placeholder the week of Nov 11; Procurement will hold the PO pending the executed MSA, but the order signature will secure the committed capacity and pricing for Aurelia. If anything shifts we'll escalate, but this keeps us aligned.

Best,
Elena
